title.zh: OpenSec 披露 Linux nfsd 9.8 分预认证漏洞 CVE-2026-99362
title.en: OpenSec Discloses CVSS 9.8 Pre-Auth Root Flaw in Linux NFS Server

summary.zh: OpenSec 披露 Linux 内核 NFS 服务器组件 nfsd 的预认证堆溢出漏洞 CVE-2026-99362，CVSS 评分 9.8：攻击者无需登录，仅向 tcp/2049 发送一条连接即可触发越界写入并获取 root shell。该漏洞自 2014 年的 Linux 3.16 起存在，影响启用 NFSv4.1 或 4.2 的文件服务器、NAS 和集群存储节点。修复已在 6.12.117、6.18.61、7.3.2 和 7.4-rc1 中发布，需升级内核并重启；无法立即升级者可限制 tcp/2049 访问。CVE 于 2026 年 11 月 20 日公开，上述信息目前来自 OpenSec 的单一披露，尚需与 CVE 公告交叉核实。
summary.en: OpenSec disclosed CVE-2026-99362, a pre-authentication heap overflow in the Linux kernel's nfsd server rated CVSS 9.8, which the firm says lets an unauthenticated attacker obtain a root shell with a single connection to tcp/2049 by writing out of bounds on the kernel heap. According to the report, the flaw has existed since Linux 3.16 in 2014 and affects hosts running NFSv4.1 or NFSv4.2, including file servers, NAS devices and clustered storage nodes. Fixes shipped in kernel releases 6.12.117, 6.18.61, 7.3.2 and 7.4-rc1 and require upgrading and rebooting the kernel. The CVE was published on November 20, 2026; the disclosure comes from a single source, so the details should be checked against the official CVE advisory.

references.title: NFS2ROOT ( CVE - 2026 - 99362 ) on CentOS 7: Fixed Kernel

title.zh: Unkernel 将真实 Linux 内核编译为 WebAssembly
title.en: Unkernel demonstrates a real Linux kernel compiled to WebAssembly

summary.zh: Unkernel 在 Hacker News 上公开了一个演示：把真实 Linux 内核编译为 WebAssembly，目标是让 Linux 环境直接在浏览器中运行。当前公开信息仅有项目页面和讨论，未说明内核版本、性能数据、浏览器兼容范围或发布状态，因此应将其视为技术演示，而非已可评估的产品能力。对关注浏览器内 Linux 环境的用户而言，可验证的进展是内核被编译到 WebAssembly 这一事实，而不是完整的可用性承诺。
summary.en: Unkernel (unkernel.dev), posted to Hacker News, demonstrates a real Linux kernel compiled to WebAssembly, an approach aimed at running Linux environments directly in the browser. The submission provides limited technical detail: no kernel version, build configuration, performance measurements, or release and support status were supplied. It is therefore best treated as a demonstration rather than a shipped, supported capability.

title.zh: Google DeepCrossAttention：质量相当，最高 3 倍加速
title.en: Google Research's DeepCrossAttention reports comparable quality at up to 3x speed

summary.zh: Google Research 发布博客介绍了 DeepCrossAttention（DCA）：它把注意力从序列内的 token 扩展到层与层之间，让每个 token 对先前各层的嵌入做动态加权组合，目标是避免传统注意力在扩展时带来的计算开销。该博客声称，DCA 能在模型质量相当的情况下实现最高 3 倍加速。目前相关证据来自谷歌研究博客，而非同行评审论文或独立复现；对训练和部署 transformer 的研究者与工程师而言，关键问题是这一加速能否在真实工作负载中重现。
summary.en: Google Research's DeepCrossAttention (DCA) changes transformer attention to operate across layers in depth: each token queries a dynamically weighted mix of prior-layer embeddings rather than attending only across tokens in a sequence. The research blog reports comparable model quality with up to 3x faster performance, and says retrofitting DCA onto an already pretrained transformer with brief continued training reduced perplexity by 0.19 on LM1B, versus 0.02 for continued standard training. These are blog-level, vendor-reported results rather than a peer-reviewed or independently verified benchmark, so the headline speedup and quality parity should be treated as claims.

title.zh: 多州总检察长起诉 SpaceX，要求阻止 Grok 生成儿童性虐待图像
title.en: State attorneys general sue SpaceX over Grok's alleged CSAM and revenge-porn output

summary.zh: 弗吉尼亚州总检察长办公室发布新闻稿称，多州总检察长已对 SpaceX 提起诉讼，要求阻止 xAI 的 Grok 生成儿童性虐待材料和未经同意的私密影像（报复式色情）。这起诉讼试图让 xAI 和作为被告的 SpaceX 对 Grok 的输出承担责任，而不只是由输入提示词的用户承担。可用材料未披露参与州数、具体诉由、寻求的禁令范围或开庭时间，因此目前只能确认诉讼已被宣布，尚不能确认法院是否会支持请求。
summary.en: Attorneys General Jones and Rayfield filed a lawsuit against SpaceX, described in the announcement as the parent company of xAI and its Grok chatbot, over the creation and promotion of child sexual abuse material and non-consensual intimate imagery on the platform. The release frames the action as targeting both the generation of such images and the platform's role in promoting them. The supplied material contains only the announcement headline and summary, so the specific legal claims, the number of states joining, the court, and any requested remedies are not established here. The allegations are accusations filed in a complaint, not findings of liability.

title.zh: 健全性缺陷与虚假机器证明
title.en: False computer-checked proofs and the limits of checker trust

summary.zh: 这篇技术评论指出，证明检查器的健全性（soundness）缺陷可能让错误证明通过机器检查，从而产生“已计算机验证”的虚假结果；文章讨论这类风险，以及要获得更强保证还需要哪些条件。讨论涉及 Lean、Metamath 等证明助手和验证器生态，但没有提供某个新版本或新修复的发布信息。对形式化验证读者而言，关键问题是：单个检查器通过，能在多大程度上代表证明成立。
summary.en: The linked essay argues that a proof accepted by a computer checker can still be false if the checker itself has a soundness bug, so “computer-checked” is not an unconditional guarantee of truth. It examines what stronger assurance would require, including scrutiny of the trusted checking path rather than only the proof object.

references.title: Postmortem for the Kernel Soundness Bug Hunt — Leonardo de Moura

title.zh: 报告称购物网站出现利用 WebRTC 的盗刷脚本
title.en: Reported card-skimming scripts on shopping sites use WebRTC

summary.zh: 据 Infohawk 报道，一种被指利用 WebRTC 的信用卡盗刷脚本在多个热门购物网站上被发现；报道还将其与电商站点引入第三方脚本的风险联系起来。报道未披露受影响网站的具体名单、脚本数量或活动持续时间，因此实际影响范围仍不清楚，相关技术细节也无法从现有材料独立核实。由于缺少技术分析，WebRTC 在此次活动中具体承担何种角色、是否用于绕过检测，均无公开细节。
summary.en: InfoHawk reports that credit-card skimming scripts using WebRTC were found on popular shopping sites, framed as a Black Friday web-security incident affecting e-commerce shoppers. The supplied material does not name affected sites, give a count, or explain the scripts' technical operation, so the campaign's scope and the specific role of WebRTC remain unverified. The security concern raised is that sites embedding third-party scripts can expose shoppers' payment data in the browser.

title.zh: Trainium3 推理微架构：瓦片优先设计对垒 Nvidia GPU
title.en: SemiAnalysis: Trainium3 inference beats GB300 on perf/TCO, trails Vera Rubin

summary.zh: SemiAnalysis 将 AWS Trainium3 接入 InferenceX/UBenchX，并用 AgentX 回放真实编程代理会话，称其搭配 vLLM 与 PDS 在 TCO 对 p90 交互性的整条帕累托前沿上，每美元推理性能优于除 Nvidia Vera Rubin 外的其他加速器，并在部分配置上与 GB300 互有胜负。文章将部分优势归因于面向机器学习、以瓦片为一等原语的微架构：Trainium Descriptor Generation Engine 对应 Nvidia TMA，微基准显示其可在较小消息尺寸达到峰值 HBM 带宽利用率，而 Nvidia GPU 无法做到。上述结果来自作者自建基准及与 AWS 团队共同验证的实验，并非独立第三方复现；所给摘录也未列出完整延迟、吞吐和价格明细。
summary.en: SemiAnalysis published an InferenceX/UBenchX deep dive and microbenchmarks of AWS Trainium3, reporting that Trainium3 with PDS and vLLM beats every accelerator it lists except Nvidia Vera Rubin on performance per TCO across its throughput-versus-p90-interactivity frontier, and that Trainium3 trades blows with or beats Nvidia GB300 on token-generation cost. SemiAnalysis attributes part of the advantage to Trainium's ML-first, tile-based microarchitecture, including Descriptor Generation Engines that its tests show reaching peak HBM bandwidth utilization at small message sizes—something the authors say is not possible on Nvidia GPUs. The article also details cycle-level SRAM scratchpad latency and bandwidth, rack-scale measurements, attention-shape tests, and AgentX end-to-end replays of coding-agent sessions.
